import Mathlib

structure DFSGraph where
  adj : Array (Array Nat)

def DFSGraph.well_formed (g : DFSGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u, u < g.adj.size →
    ∀ v, v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → v < g.adj.size

def DFSGraph.size (g : DFSGraph) : Nat :=
  g.adj.size

def DFSGraph.has_edge (g : DFSGraph) (u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  u < g.adj.size ∧
  v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[]

def DFSGraph.is_path (g : DFSGraph) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  p.length > 0 ∧
  ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length →
    g.has_edge (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0)

def DFSGraph.reachable (g : DFSGraph) (start target : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ p, g.is_path p ∧ p.head? = some start ∧ p.getLast? = some target

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def dfs_check_reachability_precond (graph : DFSGraph) (start target : Nat) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  graph.well_formed ∧ start < graph.size ∧ target < graph.size
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
def DFSGraph.succs (g : DFSGraph) (u : Nat) : Finset Nat :=
  (g.adj.getD u #[]).toList.toFinset

def DFSGraph.stepF (g : DFSGraph) (s : Finset Nat) : Finset Nat :=
  s ∪ s.biUnion (fun u => g.succs u)

def DFSGraph.chain (g : DFSGraph) : Nat → List Nat → Prop
  | _, [] => True
  | a, b :: l => g.has_edge a b ∧ g.chain b l

def DFSGraph.endp : Nat → List Nat → Nat
  | a, [] => a
  | _, b :: l => DFSGraph.endp b l
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def dfs_check_reachability (graph : DFSGraph) (start target : Nat)
    (h_precond : dfs_check_reachability_precond graph start target) : Bool :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  decide (target ∈ (graph.stepF)^[graph.size] {start})
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def dfs_check_reachability_postcond (graph : DFSGraph) (start target : Nat) (result : Bool)
    (_ : dfs_check_reachability_precond graph start target) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  result = graph.reachable start target
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
lemma dfs_getD_c0 (a : Nat) (l : List Nat) : (a :: l).getD 0 0 = a := by
  first
  | simp
  | rfl

lemma dfs_getD_cs (a : Nat) (l : List Nat) (n : Nat) :
    (a :: l).getD (n + 1) 0 = l.getD n 0 := by
  first
  | simp
  | rfl

lemma DFSGraph.chain_nil (g : DFSGraph) (a : Nat) : g.chain a [] ↔ True := by
  first
  | exact Iff.rfl
  | simp [DFSGraph.chain]

lemma DFSGraph.chain_cons (g : DFSGraph) (a b : Nat) (l : List Nat) :
    g.chain a (b :: l) ↔ (g.has_edge a b ∧ g.chain b l) := by
  first
  | exact Iff.rfl
  | simp [DFSGraph.chain]

lemma DFSGraph.endp_nil (a : Nat) : DFSGraph.endp a [] = a := by
  first
  | rfl
  | simp [DFSGraph.endp]

lemma DFSGraph.endp_cons (a b : Nat) (l : List Nat) :
    DFSGraph.endp a (b :: l) = DFSGraph.endp b l := by
  first
  | rfl
  | simp [DFSGraph.endp]

lemma DFSGraph.endp_append : ∀ (l : List Nat) (a t : Nat),
    DFSGraph.endp a (l ++ [t]) = t := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil =>
    intro a t
    show DFSGraph.endp a [t] = t
    rw [DFSGraph.endp_cons, DFSGraph.endp_nil]
  | cons b l' ih =>
    intro a t
    show DFSGraph.endp a (b :: (l' ++ [t])) = t
    rw [DFSGraph.endp_cons]
    exact ih b t

lemma DFSGraph.getLast?_eq_endp : ∀ (l : List Nat) (a : Nat),
    (a :: l).getLast? = some (DFSGraph.endp a l) := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil =>
    intro a
    have h1 : ([a] : List Nat).getLast? = some a := by
      first
      | simp
      | rfl
    rw [h1, DFSGraph.endp_nil]
  | cons b l' ih =>
    intro a
    have h1 : (a :: b :: l').getLast? = (b :: l').getLast? := by
      first
      | simp
      | rfl
    calc (a :: b :: l').getLast? = (b :: l').getLast? := h1
      _ = some (DFSGraph.endp b l') := ih b
      _ = some (DFSGraph.endp a (b :: l')) := by rw [DFSGraph.endp_cons]

lemma DFSGraph.chain_of_idx (g : DFSGraph) : ∀ (l : List Nat) (a : Nat),
    (∀ i, i + 1 < (a :: l).length →
      g.has_edge ((a :: l).getD i 0) ((a :: l).getD (i + 1) 0)) → g.chain a l := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil =>
    intro a _
    exact (g.chain_nil a).mpr trivial
  | cons b l' ih =>
    intro a h
    refine (g.chain_cons a b l').mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · have h0 := h 0 (by simp only [List.length_cons]; omega)
      have e1 : (a :: b :: l').getD 0 0 = a := dfs_getD_c0 a (b :: l')
      have e2 : (a :: b :: l').getD (0 + 1) 0 = b := by
        rw [dfs_getD_cs]
        exact dfs_getD_c0 b l'
      rw [e1, e2] at h0
      exact h0
    · refine ih b ?_
      intro i hi
      have hlen : (i + 1) + 1 < (a :: b :: l').length := by
        simp only [List.length_cons] at hi ⊢
        omega
      have hh := h (i + 1) hlen
      rw [dfs_getD_cs, dfs_getD_cs] at hh
      exact hh

lemma DFSGraph.idx_of_chain (g : DFSGraph) : ∀ (l : List Nat) (a : Nat), g.chain a l →
    ∀ i, i + 1 < (a :: l).length →
      g.has_edge ((a :: l).getD i 0) ((a :: l).getD (i + 1) 0) := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil =>
    intro a _ i hi
    exfalso
    simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_nil] at hi
    omega
  | cons b l' ih =>
    intro a hc i hi
    obtain ⟨hab, hrest⟩ := (g.chain_cons a b l').mp hc
    cases i with
    | zero =>
      show g.has_edge ((a :: b :: l').getD 0 0) ((a :: b :: l').getD (0 + 1) 0)
      have e1 : (a :: b :: l').getD 0 0 = a := dfs_getD_c0 a (b :: l')
      have e2 : (a :: b :: l').getD (0 + 1) 0 = b := by
        rw [dfs_getD_cs]
        exact dfs_getD_c0 b l'
      rw [e1, e2]
      exact hab
    | succ j =>
      have hj : j + 1 < (b :: l').length := by
        simp only [List.length_cons] at hi ⊢
        omega
      have hres := ih b hrest j hj
      show g.has_edge ((a :: b :: l').getD (j + 1) 0) ((a :: b :: l').getD ((j + 1) + 1) 0)
      rw [dfs_getD_cs, dfs_getD_cs]
      exact hres

lemma DFSGraph.chain_append (g : DFSGraph) : ∀ (l : List Nat) (a t : Nat), g.chain a l →
    g.has_edge (DFSGraph.endp a l) t → g.chain a (l ++ [t]) := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil =>
    intro a t _ he
    show g.chain a [t]
    refine (g.chain_cons a t []).mpr ⟨?_, (g.chain_nil t).mpr trivial⟩
    rw [DFSGraph.endp_nil] at he
    exact he
  | cons b l' ih =>
    intro a t hc he
    obtain ⟨hab, hrest⟩ := (g.chain_cons a b l').mp hc
    show g.chain a (b :: (l' ++ [t]))
    refine (g.chain_cons a b (l' ++ [t])).mpr ⟨hab, ?_⟩
    rw [DFSGraph.endp_cons] at he
    exact ih b t hrest he

lemma DFSGraph.reachable_iff_chain (g : DFSGraph) (s t : Nat) :
    g.reachable s t ↔ ∃ l, g.chain s l ∧ DFSGraph.endp s l = t := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨p, ⟨_, hidx⟩, hhead, hlast⟩
    cases p with
    | nil => simp at hhead
    | cons a l =>
      have hs : a = s := by simpa using hhead
      subst hs
      refine ⟨l, g.chain_of_idx l _ hidx, ?_⟩
      rw [DFSGraph.getLast?_eq_endp] at hlast
      exact Option.some.inj hlast
  · rintro ⟨l, hc, hend⟩
    refine ⟨s :: l, ⟨by simp, g.idx_of_chain l s hc⟩, by simp, ?_⟩
    rw [DFSGraph.getLast?_eq_endp, hend]

lemma DFSGraph.mem_succs (g : DFSGraph) (u v : Nat) :
    v ∈ g.succs u ↔ v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] := by
  first
  | simp [DFSGraph.succs, Array.mem_def]
  | simp [DFSGraph.succs]

lemma DFSGraph.mem_stepF (g : DFSGraph) (s : Finset Nat) (x : Nat) :
    x ∈ g.stepF s ↔ x ∈ s ∨ ∃ u ∈ s, x ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] := by
  simp only [DFSGraph.stepF, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_biUnion, DFSGraph.mem_succs]

lemma DFSGraph.subset_stepF (g : DFSGraph) (s : Finset Nat) : s ⊆ g.stepF s := by
  intro x hx
  rw [DFSGraph.mem_stepF]
  exact Or.inl hx

lemma DFSGraph.stepF_subset_range (g : DFSGraph) (hwf : g.well_formed) (s : Finset Nat)
    (hs : s ⊆ Finset.range g.size) : g.stepF s ⊆ Finset.range g.size := by
  intro x hx
  rw [DFSGraph.mem_stepF] at hx
  rcases hx with h | ⟨u, hu, hxu⟩
  · exact hs h
  · have hu' : u < g.adj.size := by
      have h2 := hs hu
      simpa [DFSGraph.size] using h2
    simp only [Finset.mem_range]
    exact hwf u hu' x hxu

lemma DFSGraph.iterate_subset_range (g : DFSGraph) (hwf : g.well_formed) (start : Nat)
    (hstart : start < g.size) : ∀ k, (g.stepF)^[k] {start} ⊆ Finset.range g.size := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    simp only [Function.iterate_zero, id_eq, Finset.singleton_subset_iff, Finset.mem_range]
    exact hstart
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply']
    exact g.stepF_subset_range hwf _ ih

lemma DFSGraph.start_mem_iterate (g : DFSGraph) (start : Nat) :
    ∀ k, start ∈ (g.stepF)^[k] {start} := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply']
    exact g.subset_stepF _ ih

lemma DFSGraph.exists_fixed (g : DFSGraph) (hwf : g.well_formed) (start : Nat)
    (hstart : start < g.size) :
    g.stepF ((g.stepF)^[g.size] {start}) = (g.stepF)^[g.size] {start} := by
  by_cases hex : ∃ k, k ≤ g.size ∧ (g.stepF)^[k + 1] {start} = (g.stepF)^[k] {start}
  · obtain ⟨k, hk, hfix⟩ := hex
    have hfk : g.stepF ((g.stepF)^[k] {start}) = (g.stepF)^[k] {start} := by
      rw [← Function.iterate_succ_apply' g.stepF k {start}]
      exact hfix
    have hn : (g.stepF)^[g.size] {start} = (g.stepF)^[k] {start} := by
      have hs : g.size = (g.size - k) + k := by omega
      rw [hs, Function.iterate_add_apply]
      exact Function.iterate_fixed hfk _
    rw [hn]
    exact hfk
  · exfalso
    push_neg at hex
    have hcard : ∀ k, k ≤ g.size → k + 1 ≤ ((g.stepF)^[k] {start}).card := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero => intro _; simp
      | succ k ih =>
        intro hk
        have h1 : k + 1 ≤ ((g.stepF)^[k] {start}).card := ih (by omega)
        have h2 : (g.stepF)^[k] {start} ⊆ (g.stepF)^[k + 1] {start} := by
          rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply']
          exact g.subset_stepF _
        have h3 : (g.stepF)^[k] {start} ≠ (g.stepF)^[k + 1] {start} :=
          fun h => (hex k (by omega)) h.symm
        have h4 : ((g.stepF)^[k] {start}).card < ((g.stepF)^[k + 1] {start}).card := by
          first
          | exact Finset.card_lt_card (Finset.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.mpr ⟨h2, h3⟩)
          | exact Finset.card_lt_card (lt_of_le_of_ne h2 h3)
        omega
    have hA := hcard g.size (le_refl _)
    have hsub := g.iterate_subset_range hwf start hstart g.size
    have hB : ((g.stepF)^[g.size] {start}).card ≤ g.size := by
      have h := Finset.card_le_card hsub
      simpa using h
    omega

lemma DFSGraph.mem_iterate_chain (g : DFSGraph) (hwf : g.well_formed) (start : Nat)
    (hstart : start < g.size) : ∀ (k t : Nat), t ∈ (g.stepF)^[k] {start} →
      ∃ l, g.chain start l ∧ DFSGraph.endp start l = t := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro t ht
    simp only [Function.iterate_zero, id_eq, Finset.mem_singleton] at ht
    subst ht
    exact ⟨[], (g.chain_nil _).mpr trivial, DFSGraph.endp_nil _⟩
  | succ k ih =>
    intro t ht
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', DFSGraph.mem_stepF] at ht
    rcases ht with h | ⟨u, hu, htu⟩
    · exact ih t h
    · obtain ⟨l, hchain, hend⟩ := ih u hu
      have hu' : u < g.adj.size := by
        have h2 := g.iterate_subset_range hwf start hstart k hu
        simpa [DFSGraph.size] using h2
      have hedge : g.has_edge (DFSGraph.endp start l) t := by
        rw [hend]
        exact ⟨hu', htu⟩
      exact ⟨l ++ [t], g.chain_append l start t hchain hedge,
        DFSGraph.endp_append l start t⟩

lemma DFSGraph.closed_chain (g : DFSGraph) (S : Finset Nat) (hS : g.stepF S = S) :
    ∀ (l : List Nat) (a : Nat), g.chain a l → a ∈ S → DFSGraph.endp a l ∈ S := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil =>
    intro a _ ha
    rw [DFSGraph.endp_nil]
    exact ha
  | cons b l' ih =>
    intro a hc ha
    obtain ⟨hab, hrest⟩ := (g.chain_cons a b l').mp hc
    have hb : b ∈ S := by
      rw [← hS, DFSGraph.mem_stepF]
      exact Or.inr ⟨a, ha, hab.2⟩
    rw [DFSGraph.endp_cons]
    exact ih b hrest hb
-- !benchmark @end lemma

    (h_precond : dfs_check_reachability_precond graph start target) :
    dfs_check_reachability_postcond graph start target
      (dfs_check_reachability graph start target h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  have hwf : graph.well_formed := h_precond.1
  have hstart : start < graph.size := h_precond.2.1
  have hfix : graph.stepF ((graph.stepF)^[graph.size] {start})
      = (graph.stepF)^[graph.size] {start} :=
    graph.exists_fixed hwf start hstart
  simp only [dfs_check_reachability_postcond, dfs_check_reachability, decide_eq_true_eq]
  apply propext
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [graph.reachable_iff_chain]
    exact graph.mem_iterate_chain hwf start hstart graph.size target h
  · intro h
    rw [graph.reachable_iff_chain] at h
    obtain ⟨l, hc, hend⟩ := h
    have hmem := graph.closed_chain _ hfix l start hc
      (graph.start_mem_iterate start graph.size)
    rw [hend] at hmem

  -- !benchmark @end proof

  ∀ u, u < g.adj.size →

  p.length > 0 ∧

    g.has_edge (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0)
